git add journals/2026-11-02-shop-down-simulate-crash.md && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
investigate: shop fully down after a /simulate/crash call exits the process

Human report (/konan): total outage, no error page. Log tail shows GET
/simulate/crash immediately followed by a CRITICAL intentional exit(1);
three independent probes (/health, /metrics, /products) all fail at TCP
connect, ruling out a single-endpoint defect. Adversarial judge validated.
EOF
)"

result_tail:
ot even an error page" exactly. Three independent, unrelated endpoints all failed the same way, ruling out a single-handler bug; a loopback connection refusal rules out firewall/DNS causes. An adversarial judge reviewed the evidence independently and validated the hypothesis.

Two honest gaps are recorded in the journal: no direct process/port snapshot (the lab's own status command wasn't available in this session, so I relied on three probe failures as a proxy), and a ~74-second window right after the crash with no telemetry, so a silent restart-then-recrash inside it can't be fully excluded.
